حدیث کا تفسیرِ قرآن ہونا دوسری آیتوں سے بھی معلوم ہوتا ہے۔ مثلاً

وَاَنْزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ (سورۃ النحل: ۴۴)

ترجمہ: اور ہم نے تم پر بھی یہ کتاب نازل کی ہے تاکہ جو ارشادات لوگوں پر نازل ہوئے ہیں وہ ان پر ظاہر کر دو۔ اور تاکہ وہ غور کریں۔

وَمَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوْا فِيْهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ (سورۃ النحل: ۶۴)

ترجمہ: اور ہم نے جو کتاب تم پر نازل کی ہے تو اس لیے کہ جس بات میں ان لوگوں کو اختلاف ہے تم اس کا فیصلہ کر دو۔ اور یہ مومنوں کے لیے ہدایت اور رحمت ہے۔

مذکورہ آیات سے واضح ہوتا ہے کہ محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم قرآن کا ترجمان مفسر بھی ہے۔ یہ تفسیرِ نبوی صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم کی احادیث میں مذکور ہے۔ کتبِ احادیث میں محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم کی تشریحاتِ قرآن و تفصیل مذکور ہیں۔

(۱) د قرآن مجید راټولول

په دې آیت کې الله تعالی د قرآن مجید راټولول او تالیف ځان ته منسوب کړي، په داسې حال کې چې الله تعالی رسول پاک ﷺ ته په هېڅ آیت کې دا حکم نه دی ورکړی چې په فلانۍ ترتیب یې راټول کړه یا فلانی آیت په فلاني سورت کې کېږده. ښکاره ده چې د قرآن مجید د راټولولو او تالیف کار محمد ﷺ سرته رسولی و. له دې آیت څرګندېږي چې د رسول ﷺ هغه کار شخصي حیثیت نه درلود، بلکې هغه ﷺ هغه کار د الله د رسول ﷺ په حیثیت او د الله تعالی په څارنه او لارښوونه سرته رسولی و.

(۲) د قرآن مجید قراءت

د قرآن مجید قراءت د الله د رسول ﷺ فعل دی. الله تعالی دا هم ځان ته منسوب کړی، چې له دې څرګندېږي چې د محمد ﷺ قراءت د الله تعالی په حکم و.

د حدیث د قرآن تفسیر کېدل له نورو آیتونو هم معلومېږي. د بېلګې په توګه:

وَاَنْزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ (سورۃ النحل: ۴۴)

ژباړه: او موږ پر تا هم دا کتاب نازل کړی، تر څو هغه ارشادات چې پر خلکو نازل شوي، هغوی ته یې څرګند کړې، او تر څو هغوی غور وکړي.

وَمَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوْا فِيْهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ (سورۃ النحل: ۶۴)

ژباړه: او کوم کتاب چې موږ پر تا نازل کړی، د دې لپاره دی چې په کومه خبره کې دا خلک اختلاف لري، ته یې فیصله وکړې؛ او دا د مؤمنانو لپاره هدایت او رحمت دی.

له یادو آیتونو څرګندېږي چې محمد ﷺ د قرآن ترجمان او مفسر هم دی. دا نبوي تفسیر ﷺ په احادیثو کې یاد شوی. د احادیثو په کتابونو کې د محمد ﷺ د قرآن تشریحات او تفصیل یاد شوي.

(1) Collection of the Holy Quran

In this verse Allah the Exalted has attributed the collection and compilation of the Holy Quran to Himself, whereas Allah the Exalted did not give the Holy Messenger ﷺ this command in any verse, that collect according to such-and-such order, or put such-and-such verse in such-and-such surah. Obviously the work of collecting and compiling the Holy Quran was carried out by Muhammad ﷺ. From this verse it becomes evident that that work of the Messenger ﷺ was not of a private capacity; rather he ﷺ carried out that work in his capacity as the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and under the supervision and guidance of Allah the Exalted.

(2) Recitation of the Holy Quran

The recitation of the Holy Quran is the act of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Allah the Exalted has attributed this too to Himself, from which it becomes evident that the recitation of Muhammad ﷺ was by the command of Allah the Exalted.

That Hadith is the commentary of the Quran is also known from other verses. For example:

وَاَنْزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ (سورۃ النحل: ۴۴)

Translation: And We have sent down this Book upon you too, so that you make clear to them the injunctions which have been sent down upon people, and so that they may reflect.

وَمَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخْتَلَفُوْا فِيْهِ ۙ وَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ (سورۃ النحل: ۶۴)

Translation: And the Book which We have sent down upon you is for this, that in the matter in which these people differ, you decide it; and it is guidance and mercy for the believers.

From the mentioned verses it becomes clear that Muhammad ﷺ is the interpreter and also the commentator of the Quran. This Prophetic commentary ﷺ is mentioned in the ahadith. In the books of ahadith the explanations and details of the Quran by Muhammad ﷺ are mentioned.

sections.title: باب 2 — متن (109)

paras.text: In the same way Allah the Exalted has attributed the explanation of the Quran to Himself. The meaning of bayan is explanation and clarification, and the detailing and elucidation of concise injunctions.
paras.urdu: اسی طرح بیانِ قرآن کو اللہ تعالیٰ نے اپنی جانب منسوب کیا ہے۔ بیان کے معنی ہیں تشریح و توضیح اور مجمل احکام کی تفصیل و تبیین ہے۔
paras.pashto: همداسې الله تعالی د قرآن بیان ځان ته منسوب کړی. د بیان مانا تشریح او وضاحت، او د مجملو احکامو تفصیل او تبیین دی.

paras.text: «ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهٗ» — that the clarification of concise words and meanings is the work of Allah the Exalted. Whereas nowhere in the Holy Quran is such explanation mentioned; such explanations are found only in the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ. From this it is known that these explanations Muhammad ﷺ carried out by the command of Allah the Exalted (by means of hidden revelation); therefore these too are included in revelation. That is why Allah the Exalted has attributed them to Himself instead of to the Messenger ﷺ.
paras.urdu: «ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهٗ» کہ مجمل الفاظ مطالب کی توضیح اللہ تعالیٰ کا کام ہے۔ حالانکہ قرآن مجید میں ایسی تشریح کہیں مذکور نہیں ایسی تشریحات صرف حدیثِ نبوی صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم میں ملتی ہیں۔ اس سے معلوم ہوتا ہے کہ یہ تشریحات محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم نے اللہ تعالیٰ کے حکم سے (بذریعہ وحی خفی) انجام دیں لہٰذا یہ بھی وحی میں داخل ہیں۔ اسی لیے اللہ تعالیٰ نے ان کو رسول صلی اللہ علیہ وآلہٖ وسلم کی بجائے اپنی طرف منسوب کیا ہے۔
paras.pashto: «ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهٗ» — یعنې د مجملو الفاظو او مطلبونو وضاحت د الله تعالی کار دی. په داسې حال کې چې په قرآن مجید کې داسې تشریح هېڅ ځای نه ده یاده شوې؛ داسې تشریحات یوازې په نبوي حدیث ﷺ کې موندل کېږي. له دې معلومېږي چې دا تشریحات محمد ﷺ د الله تعالی په حکم (د پټې وحي له لارې) سرته رسولي؛ نو دا هم په وحي کې شامل دي. له همدې امله الله تعالی دا د رسول ﷺ پر ځای ځان ته منسوب کړي.

paras.text: 2. Consensus of the scholars of the Ummah on the authority of Hadith:
paras.urdu: 2. حجیتِ حدیث پر علمائے امت کا اجماع:
paras.pashto: ۲. د حدیث پر حجیت د امت د علماوو اجماع

paras.text: The history of Islam is witness to this fact that from the era of messengership ﷺ till the present age, the Muslims of the world have been considering the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ an authority and source in religion. In this Ummah the group of the noble Companions holds limitless honour and respect in the eyes of Muslims. This very group Muhammad ﷺ described with the words "Khayr al-Qurun" (the best of generations), and the Holy Quran gave it the words «كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ اُمَّةٍ». In this group the question never came under discussion whether the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ is obligatory to act upon or not. The state of the Companions' following of the Messenger ﷺ was this: Muhammad ﷺ was delivering the Friday sermon. During the sermon he ﷺ said to the people «اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اجْلِسُوْا» (O people, sit down). Abdullah bin Mas'ud had come a little late to hear the sermon. He had just reached that place in the mosque where shoes are taken off, when he heard the words of him ﷺ and sat down at that very place, and did not have the courage to go further — so much so that he ﷺ had to say «تَعَالَ يَا ابْنَ مَسْعُوْدٍ» (Ibn Mas'ud, come forward). This is a minor example of the spirit of obedience of the noble Companions. In the era of the Tabi'in and Tabi' al-Tabi'in too, the mischief of denial of Hadith did not arise. (3) Explanation of the Holy Quran

In the same way Allah the Exalted has attributed the explanation of the Quran to Himself. The meaning of bayan is explanation and clarification, and the detailing and elucidation of concise injunctions.

«ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهٗ» — that the clarification of concise words and meanings is the work of Allah the Exalted. Whereas nowhere in the Holy Quran is such explanation mentioned; such explanations are found only in the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ. From this it is known that these explanations Muhammad ﷺ carried out by the command of Allah the Exalted (by means of hidden revelation); therefore these too are included in revelation. That is why Allah the Exalted has attributed them to Himself instead of to the Messenger ﷺ.

2. Consensus of the scholars of the Ummah on the authority of Hadith:

The history of Islam is witness to this fact that from the era of messengership ﷺ till the present age, the Muslims of the world have been considering the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ an authority and source in religion. In this Ummah the group of the noble Companions holds limitless honour and respect in the eyes of Muslims. This very group Muhammad ﷺ described with the words "Khayr al-Qurun" (the best of generations), and the Holy Quran gave it the words «كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ اُمَّةٍ». In this group the question never came under discussion whether the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ is obligatory to act upon or not. The state of the Companions' following of the Messenger ﷺ was this: Muhammad ﷺ was delivering the Friday sermon. During the sermon he ﷺ said to the people «اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اجْلِسُوْا» (O people, sit down). Abdullah bin Mas'ud had come a little late to hear the sermon. He had just reached that place in the mosque where shoes are taken off, when he heard the words of him ﷺ and sat down at that very place, and did not have the courage to go further — so much so that he ﷺ had to say «تَعَالَ يَا ابْنَ مَسْعُوْدٍ» (Ibn Mas'ud, come forward). This is a minor example of the spirit of obedience of the noble Companions. In the era of the Tabi'in and Tabi' al-Tabi'in too, the mischief of denial of Hadith did not arise. From the era of messengership ﷺ till the present age, thousands of muhaddithin, scholars and all the righteous have continued to give the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ the status of a source in religion.

(3) Explanation of the Holy Quran

In the same way Allah the Exalted has attributed the explanation of the Quran to Himself. The meaning of bayan is explanation and clarification, and the detailing and elucidation of concise injunctions.

«ثُمَّ اِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهٗ» — that the clarification of concise words and meanings is the work of Allah the Exalted. Whereas nowhere in the Holy Quran is such explanation mentioned; such explanations are found only in the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ. From this it is known that these explanations Muhammad ﷺ carried out by the command of Allah the Exalted (by means of hidden revelation); therefore these too are included in revelation. That is why Allah the Exalted has attributed them to Himself instead of to the Messenger ﷺ.

2. Consensus of the scholars of the Ummah on the authority of Hadith:

The history of Islam is witness to this fact that from the era of messengership ﷺ till the present age, the Muslims of the world have been considering the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ an authority and source in religion. In this Ummah the group of the noble Companions holds limitless honour and respect in the eyes of Muslims. This very group Muhammad ﷺ described with the words "Khayr al-Qurun" (the best of generations), and the Holy Quran gave it the words «كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ اُمَّةٍ». In this group the question never came under discussion whether the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ is obligatory to act upon or not. The state of the Companions' following of the Messenger ﷺ was this: Muhammad ﷺ was delivering the Friday sermon. During the sermon he ﷺ said to the people «اَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اجْلِسُوْا» (O people, sit down). Abdullah bin Mas'ud had come a little late to hear the sermon. He had just reached that place in the mosque where shoes are taken off, when he heard the words of him ﷺ and sat down at that very place, and did not have the courage to go further — so much so that he ﷺ had to say «تَعَالَ يَا ابْنَ مَسْعُوْدٍ» (Ibn Mas'ud, come forward). This is a minor example of the spirit of obedience of the noble Companions. In the era of the Tabi'in and Tabi' al-Tabi'in too, the mischief of denial of Hadith did not arise. From the era of messengership ﷺ till the present age, thousands of muhaddithin, scholars and all the righteous have continued to give the Prophetic Hadith ﷺ the status of a source in religion.
